      }), " 是本文的主线。它不是简单的“遍历 Pending Pod，然后找一个可用节点”，而是先建立 Queue → Job → SubJob → Task 四层工作表，再根据是否包含硬拓扑或 SubJob policy 进入不同分支。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.pre, {
      children: _jsxs(_components.code, {

      })

      }), "。因此 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "backfill"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "52-第二步queue--job--分配路径",
      children: "5.2 第二步：Queue → Job → 分配路径"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {

        children: "allocateResources"
      }), " 的主循环每次只处理一个 Job："]
    }), "\n", _jsx(Mermaid, {
      chart: "flowchart TD\n    START[allocateResources] --> Q[Pop Queue]\n    Q --> OVER{Queue is overused}\n    OVER -->|是| NEXT[跳过该 Queue]\n    OVER -->|否| J[Pop Job]\n    J --> TYPE{Topology or SubJob policy}\n    TYPE -->|否| NORMAL[allocateResourcesForTasks]\n    TYPE -->|是| TOPO[allocateForJob]\n    NORMAL --> OPS[产生 Allocate / Pipeline operations]\n    TOPO --> OPS\n    OPS --> READY{Job is ready}\n    READY -->|是| COMMIT[stmt.Commit]\n    READY -->|否| HOLD[保持 Pipelined 的 Session 结果]\n    COMMIT --> REQUEUE[剩余任务则 Job 入队]\n    HOLD --> REQUEUE\n    REQUEUE --> PUSH[Queue 按最新资源状态重新入队]\n    NEXT --> END[继续循环]\n    PUSH --> END\n"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

          children: "if"

          children: "if"
        }), " stmt != ", _jsx(_components.span, {
          className: "hljs-literal",
          children: "nil"
        }), " && ssn.JobReady(job) {\n        stmt.Commit()\n    }\n}\n"]
      })

      chart: "flowchart TD\n    T[Pop Pending Task] --> A{Queue allocatable}\n    A -->|否| SKIP[跳过 Task]\n    A -->|是| G{Scheduling gate}\n    G -->|是| GATE[必要时异步移除 Queue gate\\n仍跳过 gated task]\n    G -->|否| FIT[检查 FitError 缓存]\n    GATE --> FIT\n    FIT --> PRE[PrePredicateFn]\n    PRE -->|失败| BREAK[记录 FitError，终止本 SubJob]\n    PRE -->|通过| NOM{Nominated node}\n    NOM -->|是| ONE[优先 Predicate nominated node]\n    NOM -->|否| ALL[Predicate 全部候选节点]\n    ONE -->|没有通过| ALL\n    ALL -->|没有节点| CONTINUE{Continue allocating}\n    CONTINUE -->|是| FIT\n    CONTINUE -->|否| STOP[终止本 SubJob]\n    ONE --> SCORE[prioritizeNodes]\n    ALL --> SCORE\n    SCORE --> OP{Idle or FutureIdle}\n    OP -->|Idle 足够| ALLOC[Statement.Allocate]\n    OP -->|FutureIdle 足够| PIPE[Statement.Pipeline]\n    ALLOC --> READY{SubJob ready}\n    PIPE --> READY\n    READY -->|是| RETURN[返回 Statement]\n    READY -->|否| MORE{More tasks}\n    MORE -->|是| FIT\n    MORE -->|否| JOBPIPE{SubJob pipelined}\n    JOBPIPE -->|是| RETURN\n    JOBPIPE -->|否| DISCARD[Discard，返回 nil]\n"
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {
      id: "531-allocatablegate-和-fiterror",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Allocatable(queue, task)"
      }), " 是 Queue 级资源判断。它失败时只跳过当前 Task，不代表当前 SubJob 立刻结束。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Scheduling gate 有一条额外路径：如果启用了 Queue allocation gate，Task 通过资源检查后会被放入 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

      }), "，由后台 worker 异步移除 gate；当前 Task 仍然不会在 gate 存在时继续分配。对于只有 Volcano gate、但没有 opt-in annotation 的 Task，源码会告警并跳过。"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["Predicate 失败记录到 Job 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {

      }), "。下一次调度可能直接利用这份 fit error，避免对同一 Task 重复执行已知失败的节点检查。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: [_jsx(_components.code, {

        children: "NeedContinueAllocating"

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h4, {

    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "55-最终动作allocate-还是-pipeline",

    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.table, {

            children: "仍为 Pending"
          }), _jsx(_components.td, {
            children: "当前尝试被丢弃"
          })]

      })]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {
      id: "56-subjobreadysubjobpipelined-和-jobready",
      children: "5.6 SubJobReady、SubJobPipelined 和 JobReady"
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["普通路径每成功处理一个 Task，就检查一次 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "SubJobReady"
      }), "。满足 SubJob 的 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "MinAvailable"
      }), " 后，不再为这个 SubJob 继续分配多余 Task。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.p, {
      children: "Task 循环结束时："
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.ul, {
      children: ["\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "SubJobReady"
        }), "：返回当前 Statement；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: [_jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "SubJobPipelined"
        }), "：也返回当前 Statement，让外层继续判断 Job 是否达到整体 Pipeline 条件；"]
      }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.li, {
        children: ["两者都不满足：调用 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "stmt.Discard()"
        }), "，返回 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
          children: "nil"
        }), "。"]
      }), "\n"]
    }), "\n", _jsxs(_components.p, {
      children: ["外层 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "allocateResources"
      }), " 最终检查的是 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "JobReady(job)"
      }), "，只有它通过才 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "Commit"
      }), "。因此，", _jsx(_components.strong, {
        children: "找到一个节点、SubJob ready、Job ready 是三个不同层次的事件"
      }), "。Gang 插件正是在 Job 这一层决定是否已经满足 ", _jsx(_components.code, {
        children: "MinAvailable"
      }), "。"]
    }), "\n", _jsx(_components.h3, {

function MDXContent(props = {}) {
  const {wrapper: MDXLayout} = {
    ..._provideComponents(),
    ...props.components
  };
  return MDXLayout ? _jsx(MDXLayout, {
    ...props,
    children: _jsx(_createMdxContent, {
      ...props
    })
  }) : _createMdxContent(props);
}
return {
  default: MDXContent
};
function _missingMdxReference(id, component) {
  throw new Error("Expected " + (component ? "component" : "object") + " `" + id + "` to be defined: you likely forgot to import, pass, or provide it.");
}
